description: This file implements the source code for cellular management functions within a modem or cellular interface management module. It provides APIs for getting and setting cellular parameters, handling interface information, managing available networks and neighbor cells, and performing device management operations like reset and reboot. The code interacts with a global backend manager object, uses various helper functions, and defines multiple callback functions conforming to a configuration management framework.
